criterion_text: For supported Claude CLI versions, querying a concrete Nession Session returns accurate on-demand PID-matched `busy|waiting|idle`, `waiting_for` and conversation ID when supplied; unsupported CLI, ambiguous process or missing identity answers unknown/unavailable instead of a guessed state, without requiring a new state-tracking Hook.

verifiers.summary: The real-CLI positive path stays Pending on this runner (claude absent); deterministic negative-path fixtures passed. The on-demand status probe against a live PID-matched Session therefore remains unproven at this stage.

evidence.value: the captured `agents --json` shape parsed into typed busy/waiting/idle and background states; unknown values survived verbatim, a missing sessionId stayed null, an unlisted version was interpreted by its answer, an older CLI without the command was unsupported, and absent/unsupported/cannot-observe were each distinct and never reported as idle

The Acceptance / Cases runner provides no authenticated interactive Claude runtime: measured no runnable `claude` executable; the captured shape fixture is 2.1.326 (not an admission gate). The on-demand status probe against a live PID-matched Session therefore remains unproven at this stage.
